prediction.summary_1: False. The second sequel to the film "Now You See Him, Now You Don't" is the 1975 film "The Strongest Man in the World," which was released in the summer of 1975. prediction.summary_2: The claim is false. "The Strongest Man in the World" (1975) is the sequel to "Now You See Him, Now You Don't" (1972), not the second sequel.
